paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.72% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.51%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.94%). Brent crude changed +2.04% to 93.36. Gold changed -4.26% to 3,858.5. Bitcoin changed -9.03% to 64,900.3398. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.103%, a relative move of +2.41%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (-10.72%) and Vale (-10.02%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Diamondback strikes $5bn deal to expand drilling in oil-rich Permian Basin (FT Markets). Acquisition is latest in the heartland of the US shale boom amid volatile energy prices caused by Iran war Deals and capital markets: TG Jones put up for sale by private equity firm after less than 18 months (FT Markets). Modella Capital appoints advisers to look for a buyer after receiving unsolicited offers for the business Central banks and macro: Polish central bank freezes top court payments in escalating row with Tusk (FT World). Government accuses opposition-led NBP of playing politics in stand-off over constitutional judges Central banks and macro: Weak growth casts further doubt on Bank of Japan’s December rate rise (FT World). Real GDP contracted on a quarterly annualised basis between the second and third quarters Geopolitics and trade: Russia’s richest woman hit by EU sanctions (FT World). Founder of country’s largest online retailer Wildberries targeted in latest round of EU sanctions over war in Ukraine
